integrity: All analytic claims are proved within the included manuscript, with a separate standalone SymPy algebra checker; review is internal to the presented scientific package only. No independent mathematical audit has occurred. A potentially related 2010 full article could not be inspected in full.
scientific_limitations: Counts only positive axis-supported primitive two-cycles and their local full-space hyperbolic stability; does not classify off-axis orbits, global basins, or nonlinear behavior at neutral Floquet multipliers. The positive-population accessibility threshold is strict and the equality case is excluded.
title: Reentrant axis-cycle stability and a positivity barrier in a cyclic three-species map
